title: The Tale of the Stupid Thief
synopsis: A stupid thief tries to steal rice from a poor family.

fullText.simplified:
笨贼的故事

    有一个贼，夜里钻进一家去偷东西。可是这家很穷，屋子里空空的，除了床头放着的一袋米，没东西可偷。这个贼想：既然来了，就不能空手回去，这袋米拿回去也够吃几天的了。于是，他伸手去抱袋子。可袋子太重，他抱不动。贼眼珠一转，想出了一个办法。他放下袋子，把衣服脱下来铺在了地上，想把米倒在衣服上，包好以后带走。
    就在这时，正在睡觉的男主人醒了。他听到动静，仔细一看，见贼把衣服铺在地上要偷米。他就伸手把贼的衣服抓了过来，然后藏在了被子里。
    贼抱起袋子，把米倒了出来，伸手去摸衣服，发现米都倒在了地上。他忍不住“嗯”了一声，这下把女主人也吵醒了。女主人推了推丈夫说：“快起来！屋里好像有贼！”丈夫翻了个身说：“快睡吧！没贼。”贼听了不高兴了，他说：“怎么没贼？我的衣服刚脱在地上就不见了。”
fullText.traditional:
笨賊的故事

    有一個賊，夜裡鑽進一家去偷東西。可是這家很窮，屋子裡空空的，除了床頭放著的一袋米，沒東西可偷。這個賊想：既然來了，就不能空手回去，這袋米拿回去也夠吃幾天的了。於是，他伸手去抱袋子。可袋子太重，他抱不動。賊眼珠一轉，想出了一個辦法。他放下袋子，把衣服脫下來鋪在了地上，想把米倒在衣服上，包好以後帶走。
    就在這時，正在睡覺的男主人醒了。他聽到動靜，仔細一看，見賊把衣服鋪在地上要偷米。他就伸手把賊的衣服抓了過來，然後藏在了被子裡。
    賊抱起袋子，把米倒了出來，伸手去摸衣服，發現米都倒在了地上。他忍不住“嗯”了一聲，這下把女主人也吵醒了。女主人推了推丈夫說：“快起來！屋裡好像有賊！”丈夫翻了個身說：“快睡吧！沒賊。”賊聽了不高興了，他說：“怎麼沒賊？我的衣服剛脫在地上就不見了。”

raw.synopsis: A stupid thief tries to steal rice from a poor family.
sentence_translations: The Tale of the Stupid Thief
There was a thief who, during the night, crept into a house to steal things.
But the family was very poor, and the room was empty.
Other than a bag of rice placed at the bedhead, there was nothing that could be stolen.
The thief thought: since I am here, I can’t go back empty-handed. Taking this bag of rice back would be enough for me to eat for a few days.
As a result, he reached out his hand to pick up the bag. But the bag was too heavy. He couldn’t pick it up.
The thief rolled his eyes, and came up with an idea.
He put down the bag, took off his clothes and spread them on the ground. He wanted to pour rice onto his clothes, wrap it up and then leave.
Just at that moment, the male homeowner who was sleeping awoke.
He heard some sounds of activity, and looking carefully, saw the thief spreading his clothes on the ground to steal rice.
He reached out for the thief’s clothes and grabbed them, and then hid them under his quilt.
The thief picked up the bag and poured out the rice. He reached out to feel his clothes, only to find that the rice was all on the ground.
He couldn’t help but utter a groaning sound, this time also awakening the female homeowner.
The female homeowner pushed her husband and said, “Get up! There seems to be a thief in the house! ”
The husband turned over and said, “Go back to sleep! There’s no thief in here.”
The thief heard this and became upset.
He said, “What do you mean there’s no thief? My clothes disappeared as soon as I took them off and put them on the ground.”
